description: Best-effort read-only extraction of recent Teams chat from the local new-Teams IndexedDB cache.

onboarding.question: Do you want close-day to read local Teams cache data for asks and commitments?
setup_questions: Is the new Microsoft Teams desktop client installed?
Should Teams cache parsing be enabled as best-effort only?
connector_probes: Check for the Teams IndexedDB cache path.
Run scripts/Get-TeamsMessages.py with a dry-run output file.
